name: Transparent TLS-intercepting decrypt mirror (Phase 2)
summary: Phase 2 + 2.5 of the outbound-visibility program: an opt-in, consented, READ-ONLY TLS decrypt mirror. A local reversible CA mints per-SNI leaves; counterspy registers as the system HTTPS proxy and clients CONNECT through it, naming their destination; the proxy terminates their TLS, re-dials the verified upstream, relays byte-for-byte unmodified, and captures the decrypted plaintext (Redact-masked) as per-message InterceptedMessage events streamed to a unix socket and/or a rotating 0600 log, ingested via `console --intercept` into the console's Exfiltration view. Arm always disarms (exit/panic/signal/--uninstall). The originally approved pf rdr redirect was DISPROVED by the smoke test and replaced. Phase 2 core (CA + pump + teardown) was smoke-test verified 2026-07-16; the Phase 2.5 per-message pump + Exfiltration merge, and the fixes from the 2026-07-20/21 ABORT review (L1 secret leak, F1 relay deadlock, F-A silent-drop, Self1 self-attribution, W1 dead console path) were applied since and are NOT yet independently re-verified. Redact/block is Phase 3; a NetworkExtension transparent proxy is a later phase.
targetWindow: NOT ready to cut — pending a clean ABORT re-review of the applied fixes (no PR until fully green)
updateSource: swarm build cp-p2a..cp-p2j + smoke test 2026-07-16 + Phase 2.5 + v0.7.0 ABORT review & fixes 2026-07-20/21

required.title: CA + TLS terminate/re-dial/relay pump + publish sinks
required.summary: internal/intercept: reversible P-256 CA with a bounded, expiry-aware per-SNI leaf cache + 0600 persistence (LoadOrCreate, O_EXCL race-safe); the read-only MITM pump (GetCertificate per SNI, honest handshake classification decrypted/pinned/opaque/error, verified upstream re-dial, idle-timeout relay, bounded capture, DecodeCleartext+Redact before the flow exists); publish sinks (non-blocking socket with reader reaping + drop counter, rotating 0600 JSONL log, bounded/sanitized untrusted-input readers).
evidence: cp-p2a..cp-p2d swarm-reviewed + remediated (conn-leak, socket stall, untrusted-input bounds, body-secret masking)

required.title: intercept daemon + console --intercept view (consent + reliable teardown)
required.summary: `counterspy intercept [--stream[=sock]] [--log[=path]] [--uninstall] [--yes]` (approved surface): consent -> arm trust + system proxy with the signal handler registered FIRST -> Proxy.Serve -> reverse-order teardown on exit/panic/signal, reporting revert failures and restoring each service's PRIOR proxy setting; --uninstall is non-minting + idempotent. `console --intercept[=path]` ingests the live socket (or a --log file) into the console's Exfiltration view, joining decrypted per-message events to apps by PID; the socket is chmod 0600 + chowned to the invoking user so a NON-root console can read a root daemon's stream.
evidence: root smoke test 2026-07-16: live decrypt of real system traffic (Proton Mail Sentry telemetry, iTunes commerce), pinned apps reported honestly, Cookie masked, proxy + trust restored on exit

required.title: Replace the pf rdr redirect with a CONNECT + system-proxy mechanism
required.summary: The approved transparent pf rdr redirect was disproved in the smoke test: pf translates only INBOUND packets, so a maximally permissive rule logged 27828 Evaluations / 0 Packets against local outbound traffic. Replaced with an HTTP CONNECT proxy registered via networksetup; pf_darwin.go, pfioc_natlook, DIOCNATLOOK and the anchor machinery deleted. Also fixed the silent-drop the test surfaced (an unresolvable connection now publishes FlowError instead of vanishing).

required.title: Phase 2.5: per-message pump + Exfiltration merge + ABORT-review fixes
required.summary: Per-message streaming pump (HTTP/1.1 framing, request↔response FIFO correlation via a channel, ALPN h2-only bypass) publishing InterceptedMessage events; merged into the console's Exfiltration view via `console --intercept`, joined to apps by PID, with honest empty states and a version-mismatch footer. The 2026-07-20/21 ABORT review found and drove fixes for: L1 (credential-name masking missed compound/prefix/plural forms), F1 (relay deadlock from a synchronous tee + blocking correlation), F-A (silent capture drop on tee detach), Self1 (self-attribution excluded the wrong process), W1 (console path was dead — nil channel, path-join mismatch). All fixes applied; a clean ABORT re-review is the gate before cut.
evidence: go test ./... -race + coverage 86.3% green on the feature branch

deferred.title: Redact / block outbound payloads (Phase 3)
deferred.summary: Phase 2 is decrypt/visibility ONLY. Stripping sensitive data from outbound payloads or blocking transmission is deferred to Phase 3 (Rule 16: read-only first establishes the pump + trust model before mutating live traffic, which is higher-risk).

deferred.title: IPv6 original-destination recovery
deferred.summary: OrigDest is IPv4-only; a v6 flow fails loud rather than mis-reporting. Deferred (Rule 16): the AF_INET6 DIOCNATLOOK path + a v6 rdr rule double the unverified ioctl surface, and v4 covers the smoke test.

deferred.title: NetworkExtension transparent proxy (cover software that ignores the system proxy)
deferred.summary: The CONNECT mechanism is COOPERATIVE: proxy-honoring apps are seen, evasive software is not. True transparent interception on macOS needs a NETransparentProxyProvider — a signed .app bundle, the networkextension entitlement, Developer Program membership and notarization. Deferred (Rule 16): that is a distribution change for a tool currently shipped as a single Go binary via curl|sh and Homebrew, and the cooperative path already covers the stated use case (a trusted app phoning home). User-approved sequencing: CONNECT now, NE later.
